title: client_config.access.request
description: “Ask for early access” on the requesting device; present exactly while the effective rule access_requests is on. enabled = the rule is on and the device has access hours; available = it can ask right now: enabled, closed by the schedule (access.hours.reason schedule, switch on), no own open request, limits not reached and someone can answer (recipients or an admin notification rule for access_requested). The app shows the button on “Access again from …” only with available; requests go only over the hub WebSocket (at home: away the device holds no valid Home Assistant key while closed, the app says “Only possible at home”). The hub sends client_config_updated when available, recipients or the open request change.

anyOf.description: Hourly limit or cooldown after a No.

name.description: First name (owner label), else the device name.

recipients.description: Who gets a request now, for “Mum and Dad will get your request.”: the device that set it up first, then the devices that may set up its kind and (babysitter) the family managers, by name; each name once. Empty with available true = only the admin is notified.
